title: EvoLM: In Search of Lost Language Model Training Dynamics

predicted_errors.error_location: Section 3.1, paragraph beginning "Table 1 presents a filtered comparison favoring smaller models..."
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The paragraph claims that the comparison in Table 1 is misleading because it ignores FLOPs and parameter updates, contradicting the preceding statement that the models are compared under an equal compute budget (1B×320B vs 4B×80B, which yields identical FLOPs: 6×1e9×320e9 = 6×4e9×80e9). The self-critical paragraph directly undermines the paper's own conclusion and appears to be an erroneously included critique.

The Introduction claims the paper provides "a comprehensive, transparent, and reproducible training pipeline and evaluation framework" and open-sources 100+ models and training data. However, the Abstract states that "full training pipelines and all data cannot be fully released publicly at this time" due to proprietary portions, and only "partial evaluation scripts" are released. This directly contradicts the claim of full reproducibility and transparency.
